description: Spec §2.4 MUST: reject create/update exceeding maxSizeScript with tooLarge SetError. The trait has no way to surface this — validate_sieve_script checks syntax only, and there is no size check before create_object. Fix: add a doc note to validate_sieve_script saying backends SHOULD also enforce maxSizeScript and return Ok(Some(description)) if exceeded. Or add get_sieve_blob call before create_object to check size, and compare against a max_sieve_script_bytes() trait method (default None = no limit).
title: sieve_set: tooLarge not checkable — maxSizeScript has no backend contract
